_note: Observed JMA seismic intensity (震度) used by the validation scorecard. Scalar city records retain the legacy municipal-proxy comparison. Object records with a jma:* stationId use the exact JMA observation-point code and coordinates from jma_stations.json. Pre-October-1996 events use integer intensities because the 5-/5+/6-/6+ split did not yet exist. `mag` is JMA magnitude where available; `mw` is moment magnitude for moment-based GMPEs. Independent JMA station records are held out from coefficient selection.

_dataset.exactStationRequirement: Research-ready records must provide a jma_stations.json stationId, exact observation coordinates, and a source citation.
_dataset.limitations: Scalar records still compare a city proxy coordinate with a municipal maximum. Exact JMA observations improve coordinate fidelity but do not provide local Vs30, waveform, or instrument-response metadata; the ground-motion model therefore retains its documented site fallback.

_sources: JMA 震度データベース (https://www.data.jma.go.jp/eqdb/data/shindo/)
JMA press 2011-03-30 各地で観測された震度について
Wikipedia: 2011 Tohoku / Great Hanshin / 2016 Kumamoto / 2004 Chuetsu earthquakes
USGS / F-net focal mechanisms (src/dip/rake); Mw from USGS/Global CMT

_validation.method: Event-level split fixed on 2026-07-25. Independent events must not be used for coefficient selection. Records marked estimated remain lower-confidence references and are reported separately.
